name: Mending Old Wounds
summary: Mending Old Wounds is an avenue of reconciliation for outcasts and corsairs who have run afoul of the Steamwheedle Cartel in Ratchet. Overseen by Mupsi Shacklefridd outside the port town, this repeatable donation allows disgraced travelers to buy back standing by treating wounded sailors battered by the Bloodsail Buccaneers.

sections.title: A Price on Forgiveness
sections.body: The goblins of the Steamwheedle Cartel pride themselves on neutrality, but their patience is strictly tied to the bottom line. Adventurers who throw in their lot with the Bloodsail Buccaneers—slaughtering cartel bruisers and looting merchant vessels—inevitably find themselves marked as shoot-on-sight hostiles in Ratchet. Fortunately for the wayward, goblin pragmatism outstrips goblin vengeance. For those wishing to walk the docks without being cut down by local guards, an expensive alternative exists.

sections.title: Mupsi's Field Dressing
sections.body: Mupsi Shacklefridd waits on the perimeter of Ratchet, keeping tabs on blacklisted travelers looking to clear their names. Rather than demanding gold, Mupsi leverages the constant maritime warfare between the cartel and the Bloodsail Buccaneers. Merchant ships frequently limp into harbor carrying maimed sailors in desperate need of aid. By turning in vast bolts of linen cloth for bandaging and crystal vials for medicinal salves, former raiders can incrementally convince Ratchet's leadership that their utility outweighs past bloodshed.

faq.q: Why is Ratchet hostile toward me?
faq.answer: If the guards in Ratchet attack you on sight, you likely aligned yourself with the Bloodsail Buccaneers down in the South Seas or hunted Steamwheedle goblins for pirate favor. Ratchet remembers these offenses, making the port impossible to navigate peacefully until your standing is repaired.

Mupsi Shacklefridd is a goblin stationed outside Ratchet who manages restitution for hated individuals. Rather than letting cartel guards execute you, she accepts critical relief supplies to aid sailors injured by pirate skirmishes.

faq.q: What supplies are needed for Mending Old Wounds?
faq.answer: Mupsi demands forty bolts of linen cloth and four empty crystal vials for each shipment. The linen is repurposed into emergency bandages, while the crystal vials hold restorative draughts for injured cartel crewmen.

faq.q: Can I turn this in multiple times?
faq.answer: Yes. The task is fully repeatable and is intended to be completed many times over until your reputation with Ratchet rises back from Hostile to Neutral, allowing you to walk into town safely once more.

faq.q: Who caused the injuries to the sailors in Ratchet?
faq.answer: The wounded crewmen were battered by the Bloodsail Buccaneers, an aggressive pirate fleet locked in a vicious maritime feud with the Steamwheedle Cartel across the southern ocean trade routes.

faq.q: Will helping Ratchet harm my standing with the Bloodsail Buccaneers?
faq.answer: Yes. Aiding the Steamwheedle Cartel by patching up their sailors and providing logistical aid actively damages your reputation with the Bloodsail Buccaneers, reversing any favor you gained among the corsairs.

angles.text: Tailors hold the raw currency of redemption here; the mountain of linen bandages required to appease Ratchet makes cheap bolt weaving an essential lifeline for fallen adventurers.
Rogues tempted by the romance of privateering and Bloodsail cutlasses often find themselves reliant on Mupsi when the loss of goblin flight paths and banks becomes too inconvenient.
